synthetic_hidden_album.description: SYNTHETIC. Built by hand for PR #1434 and its follow-up because the only real extraction carrying this store is from a case that cannot be shared or sanitized. Nothing here came from a device. secured.db uses the files table CREATE statement the contributor posted on PR #1434, and the sec_pass layout follows the path shape they reported (sec_pass/<hash>/<serial>/files/<name>) with invented hash and serial segments. Every value is invented and the images are 16x16 solid-colour placeholders. Six rows: (1) _data resolves exactly to an extracted JPEG, date_added and date_modified in seconds, datetime in milliseconds, latitude and longitude set, is_favorite 1; (2) _data resolves to an extracted PNG, captured_url and captured_app set, datetime NULL; (3) _data names files/20240401_080000.jpg, which was not extracted, while a same-named file sits in another sec_pass folder, so the media column must stay empty; (4) _data, _size and every timestamp NULL or 0, which must not raise; (5) _data ends CaseTest.JPG while the extracted file is casetest.jpg, which must still link because _data is COLLATE NOCASE; (6) is_trashed 1 with date_deleted in milliseconds. Expected: 6 rows, 4 with media.

last_commit.message: Samsung Gallery Hidden Album: fix CI blockers, timestamps and media linking; add synthetic fixture
